long_biography.plain_text:
Wayne Rickert acquired Tropic Isles Mobile Home Park in Palmetto with Michael Vorbeck in 1970. The partners held the property for three decades before selling it to its residents in 2001, enabling the rental section to become a resident-owned co-operative. His other long-standing property interests have included Pegel Point Estates and Tropical Harbor Estates, where he worked in partnership with Allan Rickert and James Goss.

Rickert has also contributed to community organisations in the Bradenton area. He helped fund Manatee Community Foundation’s offices and meeting spaces, which community groups can use without charge. The Wayne C. Rickert Fund at the foundation has supported the Children’s Guardian Fund, which provides essentials and other assistance for children in state care.
